articles.title: Ukrainian drone attack on Russia's Tuapse port kills one
articles.summary: Russian officials reported a Ukrainian drone attack on the Black Sea port of Tuapse, resulting in a fire and at least one fatality. The Monday incident followed another blaze being extinguished earlier, underscoring the ongoing drone warfare between Ukraine and Russia. Such attacks highlight the persistent targeting of critical infrastructure and the evolving nature of modern conflict.
